title: 2126 Prairie's finished front now matches its 1905 photograph
items: The completed Robbins house (open it with ?structure=robbins_house_2126_prairie&version=completed on the 1904 scene) now has small-paned six-over-six windows on every floor and a single pale front door between two narrow side lights. Its fanlight now sits in a brick arch.

Its roofline drops to the photograph's: a slim stone course just over the cornice, with the chimneys showing above it. North of the house, a brick wall with a ball-topped pier now carries on from the corner. Both views of the photograph now match.
